dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0030 handles receipt point aggregation by diagnosis category.
evidence: fixed format, max line 78, no EXEC CICS/SQL
37 COPY statements typical of ORCA codebase

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — aggregates diagnosis-category-based point scores for insurance claims
purpose.summary: ORCR0030 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. It collects and aggregates point scores (診療区分別点数集計) by diagnosis category for insurance claim receipts. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2000–2006 covering various Japanese national health insurance rule changes.

notable_features: Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
237 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based batch processing
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Long revision history with named developers (MCC, NACL teams)
Fixed format with some lines over 72 chars (64 lines)
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but content is EUC-JP Japanese; comment text appears garbled due to encoding mismatch. Source is clearly genuine production COBOL from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The 7380-line file with 37 COPYs and 69 CALLs is a substantial production component. No COMP-3 is unusual for financial data but consistent with ORCA's coding style.
